metadata.title: Synthetic MPAS 4-cell OPEN strip (unit tests only)
metadata.description: Minimal OPEN-boundary MPAS mesh: a 4-cell path graph 1-2-3-4 (not a closed loop). Boundary cells 1 and 4 have valence 1; interior cells 2 and 3 have valence 2. Exercises the Route B padded-reduction boundary case: cells with fewer neighbours than max_edges must NOT acquire a spurious Dirichlet-0 term from zeroed padding slots. Pair with reader_fn that returns the matching synthetic MpasMeshData.
